blocks.zh: 驗證與常規製程控制
blocks.en: Validation and Routine Process Control

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握內毒素指示劑（Endotoxin Indicators）的製備方法：如何配製、如何標識、如何進行提取回收
blocks.en: Know how to prepare endotoxin indicators: how to formulate them, how to identify them, and how to extract and recover them

blocks.zh: 理解驗證研究中兩組對照組的設計目的及其各自的功能
blocks.en: Understand the purpose and function of the two control groups in a validation study

blocks.zh: 能夠正確計算 Log Reduction（對數去除值），並理解計算的基礎邏輯
blocks.en: Be able to calculate log reduction correctly and understand the logic behind the calculation

blocks.zh: 了解 3-log reduction 作為通行接受標準的背景，以及何時可能採用不同標準
blocks.en: Understand the background of 3-log reduction as the common acceptance criterion, and when a different criterion may be used

blocks.zh: 掌握常規製程控制的核心要素，確保驗證後的持續合規
blocks.en: Know the core elements of routine process control that keep the process compliant after validation

blocks.zh: Validation | 驗證
blocks.en: Validation

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 內毒素指示劑的設計邏輯
blocks.en: Core Concepts: Design Logic of Endotoxin Indicators

blocks.zh: Endotoxin Indicator（內毒素指示劑）：與待驗證物品相同材質和形狀的物品，人工接種已知量的內毒素，用於模擬「最差情境」的除熱原挑戰。
blocks.en: Endotoxin Indicator: an item of the same material and shape as the item being validated, artificially inoculated with a known amount of endotoxin, used to simulate a "worst-case" depyrogenation challenge.

blocks.zh: 三種可用的內毒素標準：
blocks.en: Three endotoxin standards that can be used:

blocks.zh: RSE（Reference Standard Endotoxin，參考標準內毒素）：USP 指定的官方標準品，最具法規可信度
blocks.en: RSE (Reference Standard Endotoxin): the official standard designated by USP, with the greatest regulatory credibility

blocks.zh: CSE（Control Standard Endotoxin，對照標準內毒素）：經 RSE 校準的替代標準品，可用於日常驗證
blocks.en: CSE (Control Standard Endotoxin): an alternative standard calibrated against RSE, suitable for routine validation

blocks.zh: NOE（Naturally Occurring Endotoxin，天然內毒素）：從真實環境中採集的天然 LPS，更能代表真實情境，但需先以 RSE 校準活性
blocks.en: NOE (Naturally Occurring Endotoxin): natural LPS collected from a real environment; more representative of real-world conditions, but its activity must first be calibrated against RSE

blocks.zh: 接種位置的策略性選擇：選擇「最難被沖到的部位」（worst-case location）——對橡膠塞而言，通常是產品接觸面（product contact portion）。這確保驗證的是最嚴格情境下的除熱原能力。
blocks.en: Strategic choice of inoculation site: choose the "hardest-to-rinse location" (worst-case location); for rubber stoppers this is usually the product contact portion. This ensures that depyrogenation capability is validated under the most stringent conditions.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 指示劑標識的必要性
blocks.en: Key Point: Indicators Must Be Identifiable

blocks.zh: 這個細節常被忽視但至關重要：在實際驗證中，接種了內毒素的指示劑會與大量未接種的橡膠塞一起放入洗塞機中進行驗證。
blocks.en: This detail is often overlooked but is critical: in an actual validation, the endotoxin-inoculated indicators are loaded into the stopper washer together with a large number of uninoculated stoppers.

blocks.zh: 驗證後，你必須能夠從一堆外觀幾乎相同的橡膠塞中精確找出那幾個指示劑，才能進行後續的提取和 LAL 測試。
blocks.en: After the run, you must be able to pick out exactly those few indicators from a pile of nearly identical-looking stoppers in order to carry out the subsequent extraction and LAL testing.

blocks.zh: 若無法區分指示劑與普通橡膠塞，整個驗證研究就會失效。
blocks.en: If indicators cannot be distinguished from ordinary stoppers, the entire validation study is invalid.

blocks.zh: USP 建議的標識方式（按可行性排序）：
blocks.en: Identification methods suggested by USP (in order of practicality):

blocks.zh: 使用不同顏色但相同材質的橡膠塞
blocks.en: Use stoppers of the same material but a different color

blocks.zh: 使用相同材質但不同形狀的橡膠塞
blocks.en: Use stoppers of the same material but a different shape

blocks.zh: 放入個別小網袋（individual mesh bags）
blocks.en: Place them in individual mesh bags

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 驗證邏輯如同「食品安全模擬測試」
blocks.en: Analogy: Validation Logic Is Like a "Food Safety Challenge Test"

blocks.zh: 除熱原驗證的邏輯就像餐廳衛生查核中的「細菌接種測試」：
blocks.en: The logic of depyrogenation validation is like the "bacterial inoculation test" in a restaurant hygiene audit:

blocks.zh: 食品安全稽核人員不會等餐廳真的出現汙染才評估風險——他們會在測試表面人工接種已知量的細菌，然後執行清潔流程，再測量殘餘細菌數，計算清潔效果。
blocks.en: A food safety auditor does not wait for a restaurant to become contaminated before assessing risk; instead, they artificially inoculate a test surface with a known amount of bacteria, run the cleaning procedure, count the residual bacteria, and calculate the cleaning effectiveness.

blocks.zh: 除熱原驗證完全相同：
blocks.en: Depyrogenation validation works the same way:

blocks.zh: 人工接種 1000 EU 的 LPS 到橡膠塞上（模擬最差汙染情境）
blocks.en: Artificially inoculate rubber stoppers with 1000 EU of LPS (simulating worst-case contamination)

blocks.zh: 執行沖洗製程
blocks.en: Run the rinsing process

blocks.zh: 測量殘餘 EU，計算 Log Reduction
blocks.en: Measure the residual EU and calculate the log reduction

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼內毒素指示劑要接種在「最難被沖到的部位」，而不是隨機位置？這反映了驗證設計中的什麼原則？
blocks.en: Why should endotoxin indicators be inoculated at the "hardest-to-rinse location" rather than at a random location? What validation design principle does this reflect?

blocks.zh: 在驗證橡膠塞洗塞機時，若使用 NOE（天然內毒素）作為接種材料，比使用 CSE 有什麼優缺點？
blocks.en: When validating a stopper washer, what are the advantages and disadvantages of using NOE (naturally occurring endotoxin) as the inoculum compared with CSE?

blocks.zh: 為什麼用於提取內毒素的 Water for BET 需要預熱至 37°C？這與 LAL 測試的哪個特性相關？
blocks.en: Why does the Water for BET used to extract endotoxin need to be preheated to 37°C? Which characteristic of the LAL test does this relate to?

blocks.zh: Controls & Log Reduction Calculation | 對照組設計與對數去除值計算
blocks.en: Controls & Log Reduction Calculation

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 兩組對照組的邏輯
blocks.en: Core Concepts: The Logic of the Two Control Groups

blocks.zh: 未接種指示劑（Uninoculated Indicators）：測量橡膠塞本身天然存在的內毒素本底值（resident endotoxin）。這個數值確認：你的驗證是在一個已知的基線上進行的，確保接種量（1000 EU）遠高於天然本底，不會混淆結果。
blocks.en: Uninoculated Indicators: measure the resident endotoxin naturally present on the stoppers themselves. This value confirms that the validation is carried out against a known baseline and that the inoculation level (1000 EU) is far above the natural background, so it does not confound the results.

blocks.zh: 陽性對照組（Positive Controls — 未經處理的接種指示劑）：代表「如果沒有沖洗，能回收多少 EU」，即 recoverable activity（可回收活性）。
blocks.en: Positive Controls (inoculated indicators that are not treated): represent "how many EU can be recovered if there is no rinsing", that is, the recoverable activity.

blocks.zh: 關鍵區分：
blocks.en: Key distinction:

blocks.zh: Recoverable activity（可回收活性）：陽性對照提取出的 EU，代表接種後實際可量化的起始值
blocks.en: Recoverable activity: the EU extracted from the positive controls, representing the actual quantifiable starting value after inoculation

blocks.zh: Residual activity（殘餘活性）：沖洗後從處理過的指示劑提取出的 EU，代表沖洗後仍殘留的量
blocks.en: Residual activity: the EU extracted from treated indicators after rinsing, representing the amount still remaining after rinsing

blocks.zh: Log Reduction = log(可回收) − log(殘餘)
blocks.en: Log Reduction = log(recoverable) − log(residual)

blocks.zh: 注意：Log Reduction 不是用「接種量 1000 EU」計算，而是用「實際可回收量」計算——因為部分 CSE 可能在乾燥或提取過程中損失，用可回收量才公平。
blocks.en: Note: log reduction is not calculated from the "inoculated amount of 1000 EU" but from the "actual recoverable amount", because some CSE may be lost during drying or extraction, and using the recoverable amount is the fair basis.

blocks.zh: Log Reduction 計算公式與範例
blocks.en: Log Reduction Formula and Example

blocks.zh:
Log reduction = log₁₀(recoverable EU) − log₁₀(residual EU)

範例（USP 原文數字）：
  可回收活性：4500 EU/stopper
  殘餘活性：  0.3 EU/stopper

  log₁₀(4500) = 3.653
  log₁₀(0.3)  = −0.523

  Log reduction = 3.653 − (−0.523) = 4.18 ≈ 4.17

解讀：沖洗製程去除了超過 4 個對數的內毒素活性
  (即保留了不到 1/10,000 的原始活性)

通行接受標準：≥ 3-log reduction
特殊情況：部分材料可接受 ≥ 2-log reduction
（需有科學依據說明其終端產品內毒素風險評估）
blocks.en:
Log reduction = log₁₀(recoverable EU) − log₁₀(residual EU)

Example (numbers from the USP text):
  Recoverable activity:  4500 EU/stopper
  Residual activity:     0.3 EU/stopper

  log₁₀(4500) = 3.653
  log₁₀(0.3)  = −0.523

  Log reduction = 3.653 − (−0.523) = 4.18 ≈ 4.17

Interpretation: the rinsing process removed more than 4 logs of endotoxin activity
  (i.e., less than 1/10,000 of the original activity remained)

Common acceptance criterion: ≥ 3-log reduction
Special case: some materials may accept ≥ 2-log reduction
(requires scientific justification, supported by an endotoxin risk assessment of the final product)

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 不可 Pooling，且必須校正稀釋因子
blocks.en: Key Point: No Pooling, and the Dilution Factor Must Be Corrected For

blocks.zh: 不可合併（No Pooling）：每個接種指示劑必須獨立分析，不能把多個指示劑的提取液合在一起測。原因：
blocks.en: No pooling: each inoculated indicator must be analyzed individually; extracts from several indicators must not be combined and tested together. Reasons:

blocks.zh: Pooling 會稀釋個別指示劑的數據，掩蓋批次間的變異性
blocks.en: Pooling dilutes the data of individual indicators and masks variability between units

blocks.zh: 如果一個指示劑 EU 極高，Pooling 後可能把其他「低 EU」的異常數據平均掉
blocks.en: If one indicator has a very high EU value, pooling can average out other anomalous "low-EU" results

blocks.zh: 失去評估重現性（reproducibility）的能力
blocks.en: The ability to assess reproducibility is lost

blocks.zh: 稀釋因子校正（Dilution Correction）：LAL 測試結果的單位是 EU/mL，但我們要的是 EU/stopper（每個橡膠塞上的 EU）。
blocks.en: Dilution correction: LAL results are reported in EU/mL, but what we need is EU/stopper (EU on each stopper).

blocks.zh: 若用 5 mL Water for BET 提取 1 個橡膠塞，LAL 測得 0.06 EU/mL，則殘餘活性 = 0.06 EU/mL × 5 mL = 0.3 EU/stopper。
blocks.en: If one stopper is extracted with 5 mL of Water for BET and LAL reads 0.06 EU/mL, the residual activity = 0.06 EU/mL × 5 mL = 0.3 EU/stopper.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 3-log vs. 2-log 的彈性
blocks.en: Analogy: Flexibility of 3-log vs. 2-log

blocks.zh: 3-log reduction（去除 99.9%）是業界慣例，就像「食品安全要求 99.9% 的病菌消滅率」。但這個標準是基於：
blocks.en: 3-log reduction (99.9% removal) is the industry convention, like "food safety requires a 99.9% kill rate of pathogens". But this standard is based on:

blocks.zh: 歷史實踐 + 安全邊際設計，而不是一個絕對的物理定律。
blocks.en: historical practice + safety margin design, not an absolute law of physics.

blocks.zh: USP 的彈性邏輯：如果橡膠塞本身本來就幾乎沒有內毒素（天然本底 <1 EU/stopper），那即使只能達到 2-log reduction，最終殘留量（<0.01 EU/stopper）也可能完全符合藥品最終內毒素限度的要求。
blocks.en: The logic behind USP's flexibility: if the stoppers originally carry almost no endotoxin (natural background <1 EU/stopper), then even a 2-log reduction leaves a final residual (<0.01 EU/stopper) that may fully meet the final endotoxin limit of the drug product.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 USP 要求「基於產品風險評估決定接受標準」，而不是一刀切規定所有材料都要 3-log。
blocks.en: This is why USP requires that the "acceptance criterion be determined based on a product risk assessment" rather than imposing 3-log on all materials across the board.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 的 QA 工程師正在審核橡膠塞洗塞機的驗證報告，發現以下數據：
blocks.en: A CDMO QA engineer is reviewing the validation report of a stopper washer and finds the following data:

blocks.zh: 接種量：1000 EU/stopper
blocks.en: Inoculation level: 1000 EU/stopper

blocks.zh: 陽性對照可回收量（recoverable）：380 EU/stopper（回收率 38%）
blocks.en: Positive control recoverable amount: 380 EU/stopper (38% recovery)

blocks.zh: 沖洗後殘餘量（residual）：0.12 EU/stopper
blocks.en: Residual after rinsing: 0.12 EU/stopper

blocks.zh: 計算：
blocks.en: Calculation:

blocks.zh: 是否符合接受標準（≥3 LRV）？是。
blocks.en: Does it meet the acceptance criterion (≥3 LRV)? Yes.

blocks.zh: 回收率只有 38%，是否影響驗證有效性？不影響。USP 說明 CSE 容易吸附在表面，回收率低於 50% 是正常現象，不會影響驗證研究的有效性。關鍵是使用「實際可回收量」而非「接種量」來計算 LRV。
blocks.en: Does the recovery of only 38% affect the validity of the validation? No. USP notes that CSE tends to adsorb to surfaces and that recovery below 50% is normal and does not affect the validity of the validation study. The key is to use the "actual recoverable amount", not the "inoculated amount", to calculate the LRV.

blocks.zh: 如果一個驗證研究的陽性對照回收率只有 15%（遠低於 50%），QA 審核員應如何評估？是否需要重做驗證？
blocks.en: If the positive control recovery in a validation study is only 15% (far below 50%), how should the QA reviewer evaluate it? Does the validation need to be repeated?

blocks.zh: USP 說明 2-log reduction 在某些情況下可能已足夠。請描述一個 CDMO 的實際場景，說明在什麼情況下接受 2-log reduction 是科學合理的，並說明需要提供哪些文件支持。
blocks.en: USP states that a 2-log reduction may be sufficient in some cases. Describe a realistic CDMO scenario in which accepting a 2-log reduction is scientifically justified, and state what documentation is needed to support it.

blocks.zh: 為什麼在計算 Log Reduction 時，使用「可回收活性」而非「接種量（1000 EU）」更正確？從統計學的角度解釋。
blocks.en: Why is it more correct to use "recoverable activity" rather than the "inoculated amount (1000 EU)" when calculating log reduction? Explain from a statistical perspective.

blocks.zh: Routine Process Control | 常規製程控制
blocks.en: Routine Process Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 維持驗證狀態的七大要素
blocks.en: Core Concepts: The Seven Elements for Maintaining the Validated State

blocks.zh: 驗證不是「做一次就永遠有效」——它是一個持續維護的狀態。USP 列出七項維持驗證狀態的必要實踐：
blocks.en: Validation is not "done once and valid forever"; it is a state that must be continuously maintained. USP lists seven essential practices for maintaining the validated state:

blocks.zh: Calibration（校準）：溫度計、壓力表、流量計等測量儀器的定期校準，確保 CPP 的量測正確
blocks.en: Calibration: periodic calibration of measuring instruments such as thermometers, pressure gauges and flow meters, to ensure CPPs are measured correctly

blocks.zh: Physical Measurements（物理量測）：定期確認製程參數（溫度、壓力、流速）在驗證範圍內
blocks.en: Physical Measurements: periodically confirm that process parameters (temperature, pressure, flow rate) remain within the validated ranges

blocks.zh: Periodic Endotoxin Assessment on Incoming Materials（進料定期內毒素評估）：橡膠塞、包裝材料等的定期內毒素監測，確認供應商品質穩定
blocks.en: Periodic Endotoxin Assessment on Incoming Materials: periodic endotoxin monitoring of rubber stoppers, packaging materials and similar items, to confirm stable supplier quality

blocks.zh: Ongoing Process Control（持續製程控制）：批次監測和趨勢分析
blocks.en: Ongoing Process Control: batch monitoring and trend analysis

blocks.zh: Change Control（變更管理）：任何製程、材料、設備的變更都必須評估對除熱原效果的影響
blocks.en: Change Control: any change to the process, materials or equipment must be assessed for its impact on depyrogenation effectiveness

blocks.zh: Preventive Maintenance（預防性保養）：洗塞機、水系統等的定期維保
blocks.en: Preventive Maintenance: scheduled maintenance of the stopper washer, water system and similar equipment

blocks.zh: Periodic Reassessment and Training（定期重新評估與培訓）：製程定期回顧、操作人員定期培訓
blocks.en: Periodic Reassessment and Training: periodic process review and periodic training of operators

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — Change Control 是維持驗證狀態的關鍵節點
blocks.en: Key Point: Change Control Is the Critical Node for Maintaining the Validated State

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的實際運作中，最容易破壞已驗證除熱原狀態的是「看似微小的變更」：
blocks.en: In day-to-day CDMO operations, what most easily undermines a validated depyrogenation state is the "seemingly minor change":

blocks.zh: 橡膠塞供應商更換（即使規格相同，不同供應商的表面特性可能不同）
blocks.en: Changing the stopper supplier (even with the same specification, surface characteristics may differ between suppliers)

blocks.zh: 洗塞機的噴嘴更換或維修後，水壓分佈改變
blocks.en: Water pressure distribution changing after nozzle replacement or repair on the stopper washer

blocks.zh: WFI 系統維修後，水溫或水質的波動
blocks.en: Fluctuations in water temperature or quality after WFI system maintenance

blocks.zh: 洗塞程序的 SOP 修訂（如沖洗次數或時間調整）
blocks.en: Revision of the stopper washing SOP (e.g., adjusting the number or duration of rinses)

blocks.zh: 每一項變更都應觸發正式的 Change Control 流程，評估是否需要部分或全部重新驗證（Revalidation）。
blocks.en: Every change should trigger a formal change control process to assess whether partial or full revalidation is needed.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 維持驗證狀態就像維持汽車適駕性
blocks.en: Analogy: Maintaining the Validated State Is Like Keeping a Car Roadworthy

blocks.zh: 一輛新車通過出廠測試（validation）後，並不是永遠都「安全可駕駛」的。維持它的安全性需要：
blocks.en: A new car that has passed its factory tests (validation) does not stay "safe to drive" forever. Keeping it safe requires:

blocks.zh: 定期保養（preventive maintenance）
blocks.en: Regular servicing (preventive maintenance)

blocks.zh: 定期車檢（periodic reassessment）
blocks.en: Regular roadworthiness inspections (periodic reassessment)

blocks.zh: 有人改裝或更換零件時，需要重新評估安全性（change control）
blocks.en: Re-evaluating safety whenever someone modifies the car or replaces parts (change control)

blocks.zh: 駕駛人需要更新駕照（training）
blocks.en: Drivers renewing their licenses (training)

blocks.zh: 沖洗除熱原製程完全相同——驗證確立了「出廠合格」，但維持合格需要持續的系統性管理。
blocks.en: The depyrogenation rinsing process is exactly the same: validation establishes "passed at factory", but staying compliant requires continuous, systematic management.

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 的橡膠塞洗塞機在年度維保後，噴嘴組件被更換為新款式（廠商說「功能相同，只是更耐用」）。QA 工程師需要評估是否影響已驗證的除熱原狀態。
blocks.en: After annual maintenance, the nozzle assembly of a CDMO's stopper washer was replaced with a new model (the vendor says "same function, just more durable"). The QA engineer needs to assess whether this affects the validated depyrogenation state.

blocks.zh: 評估步驟：
blocks.en: Assessment steps:

blocks.zh: Change Control 開立：記錄變更內容、廠商聲明、舊款式和新款式的技術規格差異
blocks.en: Open a change control: record the change, the vendor's statement, and the differences in technical specifications between the old and new models

blocks.zh: 風險評估：噴嘴更換可能影響的 CPP（水壓分佈、流速），對應驗證的敏感性
blocks.en: Risk assessment: the CPPs that nozzle replacement may affect (water pressure distribution, flow rate) and the sensitivity of the corresponding validation

blocks.zh: Physical Measurements：更換後測量洗塞機各噴嘴的壓力和流速，確認仍在驗證範圍內
blocks.en: Physical Measurements: after replacement, measure the pressure and flow rate at each nozzle of the washer to confirm they are still within the validated ranges

blocks.zh: 決策：若壓力和流速與驗證參數吻合，記錄為「不影響驗證狀態」；若超出範圍，啟動部分重驗證
blocks.en: Decision: if pressure and flow rate match the validated parameters, record "no impact on validated state"; if out of range, initiate partial revalidation

blocks.zh: 「Proactive control of Gram-negative bacterial contamination」——USP 開篇用「proactive（主動預防）」而不是「reactive（被動反應）」，這反映了什麼製藥品質管理哲學？
blocks.en: "Proactive control of Gram-negative bacterial contamination": USP opens with "proactive" rather than "reactive". What pharmaceutical quality management philosophy does this reflect?

blocks.zh: FDA 2004 無菌製程 GMP 指南（reference 3）在此被引用。這份文件對沖洗除熱原有什麼直接的監管意涵？
blocks.en: The 2004 FDA guidance on sterile drug products produced by aseptic processing (reference 3) is cited here. What direct regulatory implications does this document have for depyrogenation by rinsing?

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的年度製程回顧（Annual Product Review）中，沖洗除熱原步驟應包含哪些趨勢數據來展示其「維持驗證狀態」？
blocks.en: In a CDMO's annual product review, what trend data should the rinsing depyrogenation step include to demonstrate that the "validated state is maintained"?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 驗證設計核心：使用內毒素指示劑（接種已知量 LPS）+ 兩組對照（未接種指示劑 + 陽性對照），在製程前後量化內毒素活性
blocks.en: Core of the validation design: use endotoxin indicators (inoculated with a known amount of LPS) + two controls (uninoculated indicators + positive controls) to quantify endotoxin activity before and after the process

blocks.zh: Log Reduction = log(recoverable) − log(residual)，使用「可回收活性」而非「接種量」計算，以反映實際提取效率
blocks.en: Log Reduction = log(recoverable) − log(residual), calculated from "recoverable activity" rather than the "inoculated amount" so as to reflect the actual extraction efficiency

blocks.zh: 通行接受標準為 ≥3 LRV，但可根據科學風險評估調整（部分材料可接受 ≥2 LRV）；CSE 回收率 <50% 不影響驗證有效性
blocks.en: The common acceptance criterion is ≥3 LRV, but it may be adjusted based on a scientific risk assessment (some materials may accept ≥2 LRV); CSE recovery of <50% does not affect the validity of the validation

blocks.zh: 驗證後的常規製程控制需包含七大要素：校準、物理量測、進料內毒素監測、持續製程控制、變更管理、預防性保養、定期重評估與培訓
blocks.en: Post-validation routine process control must include seven elements: calibration, physical measurements, incoming material endotoxin monitoring, ongoing process control, change control, preventive maintenance, and periodic reassessment and training

blocks.zh: Change Control 是維持沖洗除熱原驗證狀態最容易被忽略的關鍵節點——任何涉及溶劑、設備、程序的變更都應評估其對除熱原效果的潛在影響
blocks.en: Change control is the most easily overlooked critical node for maintaining the validated state of depyrogenation by rinsing; any change involving solvent, equipment or procedure should be assessed for its potential impact on depyrogenation effectiveness
